title: Stats change everything
lines: Football isn't just what you see on the pitch.
It's also what the numbers reveal.
Goals, pressure, performance and patterns can show what most people miss.
THE KING STATS has worked with statistics since 2019.
Because analyzing data means seeing beyond the scoreboard.
cta: Follow THE KING STATS for more analysis.

title: The score doesn't tell everything
lines: A team won 1-0.
But did they dominate the game?
How many chances did they create? How many shots?
How efficient was their attack?
The score shows the result. Stats explain the performance behind it.

title: What is a data-driven opportunity?
lines: An opportunity shouldn't rely on a guess.
You need to read the scenario and analyze the numbers.
Then check if there's real statistical ground.
At THE KING STATS, data is part of how opportunities are identified in football and eSoccer.

title: Goals don't happen by chance
lines: Want to understand goal stats better? Start with data.
Goal averages, frequencies, recent form and team profiles build a fuller picture.
No stat guarantees the next goal.
But ignoring the numbers means leaving key information behind.
cta: Follow to learn more about football stats.

title: The mistake of only looking at recent games
lines: A team scored a lot in its last three games.
Does that mean they'll keep scoring? Not necessarily.
Good analysis needs a bigger sample, match context, opponent strength and consistency.
Statistics need context, not isolated numbers.
screen: Three games don't tell the whole story.

title: Football is also probability
lines: Probability isn't certainty.
A high-probability event can still not happen.
That's why analyzing football means understanding frequencies, scenarios and risk.
Stats don't remove the uncertainty of sport. They help you make better-grounded decisions.

title: Why analyze the first half?
lines: The first half has its own character.
Early tempo, attacking volume, goal frequency and team behavior shape the game.
That's why first-half analysis needs first-half data.
Not just full-match stats.
cta: Understand the game beyond the overall numbers.

title: eSoccer can be analyzed too
lines: Virtual football generates data too.
In eSoccer you can track results, performance patterns and event frequencies.
One important detail:
Data must be read with the competition format and the virtual environment in mind.
cta: Explore THE KING STATS football and eSoccer analysis.

title: What is a statistical sample?
lines: Imagine a team that scored in 8 of its last 10 games.
That's an observed frequency of 80% in that sample.
But careful: it doesn't mean an 80% chance of scoring next game.
Historical frequency and future probability aren't the same thing.

title: Why track record matters
lines: Without a track record, it's hard to know if a strategy really works.
Logging analysis and following results over time reveals patterns, mistakes and improvements.
In sports analysis, transparency and consistency are how you evolve.
cta: At THE KING STATS, data drives the analysis.

title: Stats without method aren't enough
lines: Having numbers doesn't mean knowing how to read them.
The real challenge is setting criteria, filtering what matters and reading each scenario right.
THE KING STATS combines technology and method to turn sports stats into organized analysis.

title: What's behind an analysis?
lines: Sports analysis is much more than looking at a percentage.
You need to know what's being measured, how big the sample is, how the data behaves and its limits.
Numbers are only useful when you know what they really mean.
